body.description: Edit ONLY the white mask containing the single blue shield knight on the prison hall left. Repose this ONE figure into a strong BACK-THREE-QUARTER elevated isometric view facing the upper-right diagonal tile axis. Show the broad BACK of the helmet and torso plus one SIDE plane of the helmet, shield and body; visor, face and front chest must NOT be visible. Align both shoulders, hips, arms, equipment, boots and both soles along that same diagonal. Preserve the identity and equipment: blue steel helmet, round shield and short weapon. Preserve the exact compact scale and same foot anchor, with both soles inside its one full original diamond tile; no widening into neighboring cells. Keep crisp stepped pixels, palette, dark outlines, contact shadow and the original continuous room grid. Preserve every black-mask pixel exactly. Do not add a character, base, pedestal, platform, ring, glow or UI.
